title: refactor(rest): move registerEmailEndpoints into email-routes.ts (#23050 slice 8)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 8 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slices 3–7's shape (PR #23670, PR #23705, PR #23719, PR #23729, PR #23763): the body of `RestServer#registerEmailEndpoints` (`POST {basePath}/email/send`, the transactional send door onto the `IEmailService` provider) moves to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts`. Routes, the ordered registrations, every handler's source digest, the published `dist/*.d.ts` and both bundles' export lists are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is, with its sum unchanged.

**No token of the body changed.** The body calls no class `static` (AST walk below), so the `static` exception the claim names up front (seat ruling `6205442867`) is not used, and no receiver token was rewritten.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 10,127 to 10,047 lines (base `f7e836da1e`). The card stays open for the later slices.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API, symbol-resolved, base `f7e836da1e`): `registerEmailEndpoints` (JSDoc `:9063`, method `:9082`-`:9177`, body `:9083`-`:9176`, 94 lines).

| kind | member | reads | class declaration |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `routeManager` | 1, the `register` call | `:2022`, private |
| field | `emailServiceProvider` | 2, both inside the handler (the wiring guard and the provider call) | `:2091`, private, not `readonly` |
| method | `resolveExecCtx` | 1 | `:2868`, private async |
| method | `enforceAuth` | 1 | `:2468`, private |

No bare `this`, no element access on `this`, no `this`-rebinding `function`, and no `RestServer.NAME` access (static reads: none). Module-level reads:

- `logError` (`./log.js`): 6 more uses in `rest-server.ts`, so it stays there; the module imports it from the same module.
- `seamOrUndefined`: declared in `rest-server.ts` (`:1493`), 5 more uses there. It is `export`ed from `rest-server.ts` and imported by the module: one declaration, never a copy. `src/index.ts` does not re-export it, so the `.d.ts` does not move (measured below). The same class of edit as slice 5's `export function mayReadPendingDrafts`.

**Mechanism hypotheses from the dispatch, measured:**

- (1) **Partly falsified.** The body reads `routeManager`, `emailServiceProvider`, `resolveExecCtx` and `enforceAuth`, and nothing else. `tenancyServiceProvider`, `kernelManager`, `resolveRequestEnvironmentId`, `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` and `readFormObjectDefinitions` are NOT read by it: they belong to the next method, `resolveAnonymousFormTenancy` (`:9185`, a forms helper; the same walk on it reads `kernelManager`, `resolveRequestEnvironmentId` and `tenancyServiceProvider`). The claim's "about 210 lines" ran past the method's end; the method is 96 lines (plus its 19-line JSDoc), and nothing past `:9177` moved.
- (2) **Confirmed.** No `RestServer.NAME(` call in the body.
- (3) **Measured;** the readers are listed below.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** `EmailRouteHost` (4 members) lists exactly the members the body reads, each typed `RestServer['m']`. The class keeps the private method with its name, docblock and position; its body is now a host literal plus `registerEmailEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`. The call site in `registerRoutes`' `registerForBase` (`this.registerEmailEndpoints(bp);`, `:4806` at base, unconditional per base) is unchanged.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (one `register` call, a top-level statement of the body) | its one swap (`:5175` / `:5179` at base) wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |
| `emailServiceProvider` | **request time**: both reads are inside the handler | not by the class (constructor only, `:2173`), but not `readonly` | **getter** |

The getter is measured, not argued. A one-off vitest file (copied in, run, deleted) boots a source `RestServer` with no email provider, drives `POST /api/v1/email/send`, assigns a provider on the instance AFTER `registerRoutes()`, and drives it again:

- this head: `501` then `200` (`MEASURE provider-after-registration: 501 -> 200`), the late provider's `send` called once. A second case sets `resolveExecCtx` and a spy on `enforceAuth` AFTER `registerRoutes()`: both are the ones the door calls (`sentBy: 'late-user'` stamped). `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- by-value ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the literal's `get emailServiceProvider() { return readEmailServiceProvider(); },` replaced by `emailServiceProvider: this.emailServiceProvider,` (anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `2ba4159180` → `aad755d1ef`). The door freezes at registration: `expected … [ 200 ]`, received `501`. `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`. Restored by the tool's trap: blob `2ba4159180` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty. Source path (relative import), so no `dist` leg applies.
- the same file against the BASE source (base `rest-server.ts` restored into the tree with a trap, then `git checkout HEAD` and blob/diff proof): `501 -> 200`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`, the same answers as the head.

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` built at base `f7e836da1e` (this worktree, before any edit), at the move commit `679fe5b05` and at the merge head `35f207b70` (and again after the whole-workspace build) are byte-identical: sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all files, `cmp` silent. The head bundles carry a head-only marker (`readEmailServiceProvider`: 2 hits in each of `index.js` and `index.cjs`, 0 at base), so the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source, not replayed. `EmailRouteHost`, `email-routes` and `seamOrUndefined` appear 0 times in the `.d.ts`; `src/index.ts` is untouched.
- **Export lists:** the base and merge-head ESM and CJS bundles each load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…` on all four). No email or `seamOrUndefined` name is among them.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that answers every member, dumped under slice 7's seven configs: default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; and both off under scoped-optional. Each dump holds `getRoutes()` (functions as arity), the ordered server registration calls, and a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source plus the source itself.
  - **28 of 28 dump files byte-identical**, base vs move commit and base vs merge head: routes, calls, handler digests and handler sources in every config. default 75 routes (1 email door), scoped-optional 150 (2), scoped-required 75 (1), every-provider-set equals default, discovery-off 73 (1), openapi-off 73 (1), both-off-scoped-optional 142 (2). A second base run was identical to the first.
  - Because no token changed, every handler digest is identical, the email door's included (9 email handlers over the seven configs), with no mapping.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control changed one character of the moved handler (`'[REST] Email send unhandled error:'` → `…error!'`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`; anchor 1 → 0, blob `30a8f5a0c8` → `78879bb810`). Routes and calls were unchanged in all seven configs, and the handler digests differed in exactly the email door of each mounted base (`POST /api/v1/email/send`, and `POST /api/v1/environments/:environmentId/email/send` where scoped), nothing else. Restored, blob `30a8f5a0c8` equals `HEAD`.
- **Moved body:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 9083-9176, one 4-space indent removed, against `email-routes.ts` lines 70-163: `diff` exits 0 (94 lines). The body has no whitespace-only line, no trailing whitespace and no template literal spanning lines.
- **Moved-line accounting:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change` base → `679fe5b05` over the two files: all 94 deleted body lines are detected as moved; the one other deleted line is `seamOrUndefined`'s declaration gaining `export`. `rest-server.ts` is +15 / −95 there: the stub body (host literal plus `.call`, +12 / −94), the module's import and its comment (+2), and the `export` (+1 / −1).

Those reads moved: `readSites` over base `rest-server.ts` found `:9093`, `:9122` (invocation `:9122`, wrapped by `seamOrUndefined(`); at the move commit `rest-server.ts` holds only the host literal's getter line, so `wrappedIn('emailServiceProvider', 'seamOrUndefined(')` read 0 and the test went red. The controls now read `email-routes.ts` (`EMAIL_SOURCE`): reads `:80`, `:109`, invocation `:109`; `seamOrUndefined(` 1, `wiredEngineOrLoud(` 0, as before. The `objectQLProvider` census itself (3 consumers over `SLOT_FILES`) is unchanged, and `SLOT_FILES` is not widened (the module holds no `objectQLProvider` site).

## Acceptance notes

- **The provider's call receiver, measured.** The handler calls `this.emailServiceProvider!(environmentId)`; through the host that call's receiver is the host literal, where at base it was the `RestServer` (the one-off file's third case records `receiver === server`: `true` at base, `false` at head). Only a provider written as a non-arrow `function` that reads `this` could observe it. The shipped provider (`rest-api-plugin.ts`, about `:406`) is an `async` arrow, and the constructor parameter's type declares no `this`. Every earlier slice that moved a provider call through a getter (`objectQLProvider`, `approvalsServiceProvider`, the two sharing providers, `analyticsServiceProvider`, `securityServiceProvider`) has the same property. Recorded, not changed: a bound hand-over would be a new host shape, which this slice may not introduce.
- The moved `[#15405]` comment's references ("the `if (!this.emailServiceProvider)` guard above", "`rest-api-plugin.ts` hands over") still read true in the module.
